title: Wall Mount Shower Squeegee 15-Inch Solid Brass With Hook | Antique Bronze | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your daily shower cleanup with a wall mount shower squeegee crafted from solid brass to help reduce water spotting on shower doors, tile, and mirrors in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability.

  • Antique Bronze brings rich depth and character
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Built for bathroom use: Designer finish provides corrosion-free and rust-free performance.
  • Traditional look: Complements traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures.
  • What’s included: Squeegee, blade, mounting hook, and all installation hardware.

Specs
Overall size: 10-Inch L x 10-Inch W x 15-Inch H
Projection: 3-Inch
Mounting type: Wall mount
Weight capacity: 2 lb
Product weight: 3.2 lb
Assembly required: No
Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

_previous.title: Shower Squeegee with Smooth Handle
_previous.description: Use this shower squeegee to remove moisture in quick and easy strokes. Keep your tile, mirrors and shower doors spot-free by removing excess water after your shower. The decorative mounting hook will keep your squeegee securely supported when properly installed in the wall. Squeegee is made of the finest solid brass materials and provided with one of our designer lifetime finishes.
